facts.fact: 一头雄鹿踏着白蹄落地，随即朝妹妹 Jingling 所在的位置冲去；Kiamling 嘴里迸出一声含混的警告尖叫。
facts.anchor: A majestic stag landed on white hooves. The beast charged towards her sister’s position as a garbled shout of warning screeched from Kiamling’s mouth.

facts.fact: Kiamling 踩着地板、竹子和树枝奔向雄鹿，从鹿头上一跃而过时被鹿角撕开大腿；她仍跨坐到了鹿背上（背对鹿头）。
facts.anchor: With that she ran towards the stag, feet moving from floor to bamboo to tree branch. As she vaulted over his head, his antlers tore into her thigh, slicing it open.

facts.fact: 雄鹿自称 Merlin，说自己是先知中最智慧者、德鲁伊中最伟大者，并当面宣告 Au Kiamling 会给所有人带来毁灭。
facts.anchor: “I am Merlin, wisest of prophets, greatest of druids. And you, Au Kiamling, will bring doom upon us all.”

facts.fact: 原来 Kiamling 骑在鹿背上时已把红绳抖开，绕着房间盘成歪斜的螺旋；绳子缠在竹枝树杈间，绳头正挂在鹿角上。
facts.anchor: Spread around the room in a jerky spiral was the red string Kiamling had unspooled as she straddled the stag’s back. It lay tangled up in the bamboo and branches like gossamer cobwebs.

facts.fact: Kiamling 的铜钱剑仍插在巨树顶端一侧的裂缝里；那裂缝是通往异界的界隙，这次不通往 fae 之地，而是别处。
facts.anchor: Her coin sword was still embedded in the top of the tree, at the split that ran down one side. A rift between realms – not the fae, but somewhere else this time.

facts.fact: Kiamling 推断变形者想把 Madam Yau 封进树里、以她的死撑开门好放更多 yiugwai 进来；反过来说，把变形者自己封进去就能把门关上。
facts.anchor: The shapeshifter wanted to seal Madam Yau in the tree, her death propping the door open for more yiugwai to come through. In which case the opposite might also be true: sealing him inside would close it.

facts.fact: Madam Yau 主动提出由自己当诱饵，理由是 Merlin 最恨的就是她；她摇晃着站起，九条尾巴在身后像展开的扇子般抖动。
facts.anchor: “I’ll do it. After all, it’s me he detests.” Madam Yau rose to her feet unsteadily. Her nine tails flicked behind her like an open fan.

facts.fact: Merlin 缩身变成一只蓝灰背、锈红斑点的猛禽，俯冲下来用利爪抓伤 Jingling 的手臂，并不停起落以爪喙骚扰两姐妹。
facts.anchor: Jingling shrieked as a claw caught her arm, Kiamling batting the ferocious bird away before he could do more harm. He would not keep still, flying up and diving down to harass them with talons and beak.

facts.fact: Madam Yau 不断胀大，生出白毛、脸拉长为狐狸的三角吻部，变成小象般高大的巨狐，把两姐妹护在身后。
facts.anchor: Madam Yau grew bigger. White fur lined her skin and her sharp face elongated into the triangular snout of a fox. She towered over them, the size of a small elephant.

facts.fact: Kiamling 先用自己的软底凉鞋去打写有 Merlin 名字的符纸却打不破，Jingling 便解下一只硬底皮靴递给她，这回纸很容易就撕开了。
facts.anchor: “Use mine,” Jingling said, eyes bright. She unlaced a fancy leather boot with a hard sole.

facts.fact: 念咒时 Kiamling 眼前突然变成无始无终的墨色黑暗，她被仙女环里见过的那些无脸身影围住，它们同步逼近、收紧绳套。
facts.anchor: Words of power that lingered in the air, calling across the veil. Suddenly she faced an ink-like darkness without beginning or end. Encircled by the faceless bodies she had seen within the fairy ring.

facts.fact: 变成拄杖老人的 Merlin 举杖指向 Madam Yau，一群猎犬从近旁树上的瘤节里跃出，牙齿咬进这只 wulei jing 的白毛里。
facts.anchor: He aimed the staff at Madam Yau, and a pack of hunting dogs leapt out of a knotty burr on a nearby tree, their teeth sinking into the wulei jing’s white fur.

facts.fact: lui gwei 们哀鸣着拽住 Merlin 的袍子拖慢他，被它们碰到的部位手指变成银色、把他的 qi 抽走；Kiamling 因此判断他体内藏着一个凡人宿主。
facts.anchor: The lui gwei moaned and pulled at his robes, slowing him down. Where they touched him, their transparent fingers turned silver, leaching the qi from him.

facts.fact: 咒语念完却需要"喂给虎"；Kiamling 想起 Por Por 曾在饿鬼节当着 Reverend Nairns 的面吞下诅咒，便把写有 Merlin 名字的碎符纸塞进嘴里嚼碎吞下，由自己充当那只虎。
facts.anchor: She recalled Por Por swallowing the curse in front of Reverend Nairns at the Hungry Ghost Festival. Desperate times and all that. She put the wad of shredded paper into her mouth and chewed.

facts.fact: 厄运应验：Merlin 被自己的袍子绊倒，手杖一撑即断成两截、上半截敲中他的太阳穴；Kiamling 抢上连点他的定身穴，双掌拍胸把他打飞进树洞。
facts.anchor: He leant on his staff, but it snapped clean in half on impact, the upper portion knocking him across the temple. Kiamling ran forward, hitting his paralysis points in rapid succession before she slammed both palms on his chest.

facts.fact: 被叫醒的 Madam Yau 召来乌云，用带爪的手指引来一道帆船桅杆般粗的锯齿状闪电，击中铜钱剑并沿树干劈下，把树烧得噼啪作响。
facts.anchor: A single jagged lightning strike pierced down, thick as the mast of a junk ship, hitting the coin sword and tearing down the massive tree trunk, shimmering under the crackled bark to show every wrinkle.

facts.fact: 树缝合拢封住 Merlin 后，Kiamling 才明白 Madam Yau 为何痛哭：lui gwei 为了救她们全体牺牲，也被一同封在树里，再无进入下一轮轮回的机会。
facts.anchor: Only then did Kiamling realise why the wulei jing was so upset. The lui gwei had sacrificed themselves. For her. Trapped in the tree also, with no chance of rejoining the cycle of life for another turn.

facts.fact: 树皮上最后定形的脸被认出是常客 Secretary Francis Peake；此时大门被撞开，Archie 气喘吁吁地站在门口。
facts.anchor: “Secretary Francis Peake,” Madam Yau said, voice wrung out. “He’s a regular.” The main door burst open behind them. Archie stood there, out of breath.
